_reader: no loader reads this file yet; check_fairness.py does not glob knowledge/world (fact 2), and nothing in ai_player's play code may read it until a loader and a KNOWLEDGE_FIELDS classification exist

_notes.labels: every reachable script label whose body changes saved state by a listed op; maps by reference (R-2: every map whose map.json event or map script reaches it)
_notes.changes: in label order: setflag, clearflag, setvar, addvar, subvar, copyvar, settrainerflag, cleartrainerflag, warp, special, trainerbattle. The register_matchcall macro is listed as special SetMatchCallRegisteredFlag with its trainer (asm/macros/event.inc:1970: it sets the trainer's saved Match Call flag, src/pokenav_match_call_data.c:1160). NOT LISTED, so a label's changes are not all it does: removeobject (an object's hide flag), the give/take commands (items_gifts.json), money, coins, set*warp, setrespawn, frontier/contest/apprentice macros, other macros that hide a special (seteventmon: special CreateEnemyEventMon, asm/macros/event.inc:1995), and whatever a special's C code writes (a special's effect is never read here)
_notes.conditional: false only when every earlier line of the label always runs on (SAFE, or a call whose callee provably returns); true otherwise, with those lines in dev.after. The label itself runs only as its triggers say
_notes.effect: words only for settrainerflag, cleartrainerflag, warp and register_matchcall (a cited template filled from a join); null for every flag/var change, every other special and every battle: their meaning is never written from a name
_notes.trigger: the DIRECT ways in: talk (object), sign, coord (dev test), map_script (on_transition, on_frame, ...; a table entry's dev test), battle (the post-defeat script of that trainer), called (by another label: how, and the dev test of a conditional jump), C (a src/ line)
_notes.gates: candidates from two patterns (steer: a coord trigger that moves the player and changes no saved state; locked: a goto_if on saved state whose branch ends without a warp while the way on warps); `when` words only from the cited hand table GATE_WORDS, else null and listed in _gates_when_null
_notes.dead: labels with a listed op that nothing reaches, and op lines after a never-continuing command in their label; never in an AI-facing record
_notes.excluded: temp / special / scratch writes (persistent only), mystery gift and record-mixing scripts (R-3), counted
_notes.copyvar: a copyvar from a literal is unknown (vanilla copyvar bug, scrcmd.c:371) (R-3: vanilla reads through a NULL pointer)
